intent: Make the bash tool's system-prompt snippet explicit that timeout is measured in seconds, preventing models from passing millisecond values like 120000 for a two-minute cap.

references.reason: Observed gpt-5.5 repeatedly passing bash timeout=120000 after reading test code with timeoutMs values; Pi correctly interprets bash timeout as seconds, so the model-facing snippet needs the unit.
